<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Explaining encoding error cause**

The encoding error dialog arises because JSONSerialization in MiataruAPIClient.updateLocation fails when the location payload contains non-finite numbers (NaN/±inf), which can happen after app resume when CoreLocation returns invalid speed, altitude, or accuracy values. This triggers the overlay shown in the map view catch block. The root cause is that LocationManager.sendLocationToServer forwards these raw values without filtering. Adding guards to exclude or replace non-finite metrics before encoding should prevent the error. Relevant code sections include payload building in LocationManager (lines 259-306), JSONSerialization in MiataruAPIClient (lines 445-512), and map view error handling (lines 818-827).</details></think>

Likely cause: the dialog is shown when the app hits the `encoding_error` path. That error is only raised if the request JSON cannot be encoded, which happens when the location payload contains non‑JSON numbers (NaN/±inf).             Timestamp: String(Int64(timestamp)),
            Longitude: longitude,
            Latitude: latitude,
            HorizontalAccuracy: accuracy,
            Speed: speedValue,
            BatteryLevel: batteryPercent,
            Altitude: altitudeValue
        )
    }

'''
